theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (E M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ), E ⊆ M → NullMeasurableSet E (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q ↔ HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E θ x Q
